subject: I wasn't going to share this secret handicapping hack
preview_text: Found something in the data I've never shown anyone. This changes how you'll pick winners forever.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was running some late-night analysis on last month's Cheltenham results, cross-referencing our AI predictions with the actual payouts. I found a pattern so obvious I almost deleted it. Thought it was a glitch. Ran it again. And again. It wasn't a mistake.

Turns out, when you layer jockey confidence scores over specific track conditions at a certain time of day, the AI's win rate spikes by a ridiculous margin. I built a separate, hidden algorithm just to track it. Wasn't planning to release it—felt like giving away the crown jewels. But today, I'm enabling it for you.

It's live right now in the app. Go to any racecard, tap the three dots next to the AI Confidence Score, and select 'Advanced Conditions Filter.' You'll see a new toggle for 'Jockey-Track Sync.' Flip it on. Watch the rankings reshuffle. The horse that was 3rd might jump to 1st with a 95% confidence score. It's that powerful.

Open the app and try it on the next race. See what the data shows you. This is the edge the pros pay thousands for. P.S. This filter is active for your account for the next 72 hours. After that, it goes back in the vault. Use it or lose it.
